effect.text: A keeper of the Watch list slips you a folded page: three House names, sums beside them, and the posts each one pays.

triggers.note: A favour done for a keeper who asked one first (or the Fish Hall keeper reported): her or his piece of the list, which counts as the favour-keeper's piece the whole list needs.

effect.text: Sergeant Bettany Nailley hands you the page that was sewn into the Fish Hall keeper's hood: her own piece of the Watch list.

triggers.note: The whole Watch list: a story item, and the first whole list starts the five game days in which the holders choose.

effect.text: Three pieces, one from a keeper who asked a favour: the whole Watch list. Now decide where it goes: the sergeant, the Press, the Captain, or the Counting House.

triggers.note: A holder of the whole list chooses where it goes, at one of the four (campaign Ch 3's table): the choice is tallied by the holder's voice (each at least 1) until the lists close.

effect.detail: carried the Watch list where it belonged

effect.text: {carrier} was the first to carry the whole Watch list where it belonged.

triggers.note: The harness Hakon left on the Upper Mere ridge, or the copy of the carters' wagon board left in the yard at night: the story's own item, for the wolf whose side story waits on it.
The customs collector shows the Crown's customs tally to a wolf on the treasurer's errand, and lets it go with them.
Two favours end at a door (both homes, so the story opens neither): the treasurer's after her day's work, the young usher's by night.

effect.text: The treasurer opens her own door, reads the tally twice by the step lamp, and hands you a folded page from her sleeve.
At the Weavers' Terrace door the herald's apprentice takes the usher's note, reads it, and nods you back to him.

phases.journal: Act I, The Lamp, is done. The realm waits for the howls: the next act begins when the Council sends for them.

effects.text: The first act of the Moot is done. The ridges are watched and the roads are counted. The herald waits on the Council for the howls. (signed) the Herald of Ridgemere

phases.journal: The Lamp is lit. The howls are next; Act I keeps its last holds until the Moot Night begins.

triggers.note: Act III has started: the dismissed guard this act held in the cells (or on the Greyteeth road) is let go, so the Moot Night can hold him, try him and outlaw him.
The campaign's last chapter has ended (or was stopped): this act's run ends too, and what it still holds (its spared cast, its talk not kept) is let go.

actions.text: Act I, The Lamp, is put away with the Moot.

quests.title: Douse a Lamp
quests.summary: Somebody burns lamps on the ridges at night, two long and one short. Stand on a ridge where one burns, and it burns no more.

rewards.detail: doused the Captain's lamp on the downs

objectives.label: Stand on a ridge where a lamp burns, between the ninth hour of the night and the fourth, until the hour turns.

quests.title: Who Pays the Watch
quests.summary: Some wolves of the city keep a list of which Houses pay the Watch to look away. Gather three pieces, one from a keeper who asks a favour first, and decide where the whole list goes.

objectives.label: Gather three pieces of the Watch list from those who keep one.
Get one piece from a keeper who asks a favour first.
Take the whole list to the sergeant, the Council Press or the Captain of the Watch. Or sell it.

quests.title: The Treasurer's Tally
quests.summary: The Crown's treasurer keeps a list too, they say, and will trade a page of it for the Crown's own customs tally, brought to her door after her day's work.

objectives.label: Ask the customs collector at the Customs House to show you the Crown's customs tally.
Bring the tally to the treasurer's door at Stanmore House, between the eighteenth hour and the twenty-second.

quests.title: A Night in the Cells
quests.summary: The keeper of the cells will give you his piece of the list if you sit one night in the cells for him.

offer.ask: They say you keep a list.
offer.say: #greet#. A list? I might keep one. I'd keep it better if somebody sat a night in the cells while I'm home. They whisper down there after dark. Sit one night, the second hour, and tell me what you heard.
offer.accept: I'll sit a night in the cells.
offer.handIn: I sat the night. Nobody came but the rats.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Nobody comes when somebody's sitting. That's the whole trick of a Watch. Here. Don't read it near the Captain.
offer.during: The second hour of the night, in the cells. Take the stair down from the office; the door's open to you while this lasts.

objectives.label: Sit in the Keep's cells at the second hour of the night.

quests.title: After the Restday Service
quests.summary: The abbot shares his list only with a wolf who came to the Restday service and then asked him in the crypt.

offer.ask: Do you keep a list, Abbot?
offer.say: #greet#. Come to the Restday service first. The Bright One hears a question better from a wolf who has sat still. Then go down to the crypt, and come and ask me what you came to ask.
offer.handIn: I heard the service, and I've been down in the crypt.
offer.thanks: Then you've earned the page. It lists the Houses whose candles are bought with the Watch's silence. Keep it out of the rain, and out of the Counting House.
offer.during: Restday, the tenth hour, and then the crypt. The Bright One keeps the hours better than I do.

objectives.label: Hear the Restday service in the cathedral, at the tenth hour of Restday.
Go down into the crypt, where the abbot keeps what he keeps.

quests.title: The Usher's Note
quests.summary: A young usher of the Antechamber keeps a list, and wants a note carried by night to the herald's apprentice first.

offer.ask: Is it true you keep a list?
offer.say: #greet#. I do. Carry this to the usher who trains under the herald, at her door on Weavers' Terrace, after dark. Don't open it. Then come back and the list's yours.
offer.handIn: Your note is at her door.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Here. I copied it twice, so the one I keep and the one you carry say the same thing. Don't let the Captain see you with it.
offer.during: Weavers' Terrace, after dark. Knock once and wait.

objectives.label: Carry the usher's note to the Weavers' Terrace door by night, between the nineteenth hour and the fourth.

quests.title: The Most Suspected Wolf in Ridgemere
quests.summary: Half the city believes old Kendrick a thief. Sergeant Dagny Ropeley has never caught her near a thing that wasn't hers.

offer.ask: Any trouble the Watch would like help with?
offer.say: #greet#. Old Kendrick's believed a thief by half the city. I've never once caught her near a thing that wasn't hers. Want to prove me right?
offer.accept: I'll find who it really is.
offer.handIn: It's the Fish Hall keeper. Her papers stink of the same oil as the stolen goods.
offer.thanks: Blood and bread, I knew it. I'll have her up before the magistrate, and the old wolf can sit on her bench without half the street watching her paws. #thanks#.
offer.during: Start at the Pawn and Ledger. Stolen goods all end up there sooner or later, and they all smell of where they came from.

rewards.subject: rmx_ingrid_kendrick
rewards.claim: stole a thing in her life

rewards.subject: rm_corra_coalcot
rewards.claim: sells stolen goods out of the Fish Hall

rewards.text: There's the one. Half the street looked at my paws for a year, and you looked at the Fish Hall. #thanks#. I'll not forget your face.

objectives.label: Ask at the Pawn and Ledger who brings it the city's stolen goods.
Follow the fish-oil smell to the Fish Hall.
Smell the papers the Fish Hall keeper sells under the counter.

quests.title: Lamp-Black on the Snow
quests.summary: A grey-cloaked wolf stands on the Upper Mere ridge at night, and says nothing. Frosthollow's Keeper may know the scent.

rewards.detail: brought Ulric Stonevein the lamp-black harness

objectives.label: Put out the lamp on the Upper Mere ridge, and pick up what the grey-cloaked wolf leaves there.
Give the harness to Ulric Stonevein at the Frosthollow mine.
Ask Ulric about the harness.
Ask the keeper of the rolls at the Records Office for Frosthollow's winter record.
Tell Ulric what the lamp-oil list says.

quests.title: The Shepherd Who Watches the Road
quests.summary: Somebody at the Greyteeth shearing barn counts the ridge lamps. Count them with him, three nights, and see who he counts them for.

rewards.detail: caught out the shepherd who counted the ridge lamps

objectives.label: Count the lamps from the Greyteeth shearing barn, at the twenty-third hour, on three nights.
Settle it with the shepherd, in his window at the barn.

quests.title: The Dismissed Guard
quests.summary: A Palace guard with no Palace drinks with the carters and has money he did not earn guarding anything.

rewards.detail: caught the dismissed guard who sold the wagon days

objectives.label: Ask Desmond Hollis what happened to his post.
Watch the Carters' Yard by night, and take what is left there for a buyer.
Give the copied wagon board to Sergeant Bettany Nailley.

tests.name: One active wolf: one lamp, twelve days, it moves itself on; every default at the close
Five active wolves: two who took part are not enough, the third makes it ready
Two hundred active wolves: fifty-nine are not enough, sixty are
Advance anyway on the third day: pushed; the list carried in the closing; the DM ends the act
The soft maximum with auto off: not ready after forty days
The soft maximum with auto on: it moves on by itself at thirty-six days
The bar waited for: participation and time met, the bar short, not ready
Three waves at Glasswater, both posts, four dark nights, the Blaze, the Ridge-walkers
The Watch list to the sergeant: two pieces, a night in the cells, the whole list
The Press prints it: the treasurer's tally, the abbot's service, the louder voice wins
The Captain burns it: the usher's note carried by night
Sold to the Counting House: Kendrick cleared, the Fish Hall page, a fake bought
Desmond Hollis held, the shepherd shamed, the lists lost at the close
The shepherd turned: the ambush at Glasswater; a later wolf finds him settled; one picks after him
Lamp-Black on the Snow and the door quest
Pledges, backings, the Question, a pack's news, a choice laid again at the close
